horoscopes.horoscope: With your substantial inter-personal abilities, you will accomplish a great deal today, says Ganesha. Your power of expression will impress many people. Financial rewards are on the cards, but be cautious about minor accidents and illnesses. After office, catching up with your old friends or chilling out with new pals will be the first thing on your mind. After all, you enjoy the company of the friends who support you always everywhere. Therefore, spending a special time with your special friend will bear something meaningful to you, feels Ganesha. Ganesha says that you are likely to get exhausted while doing your routine tasks. Do not hesitate – seek assistance of juniors and seniors in your workplace to complete difficult tasks. Then, take a break to rejuvenate your mind and body. You might have to spend on the health of elderly members of your family. Chances of very high range expenses while are very less, you are likely to spend money on small small requirements. Today, you will tickle everyone’s funny bone with your incredible sense of humour. However, at work, you will be serious and pay more attention to the projects under your purview, says Ganesha. You will be ready to give your best shots and be the ultimate champion in finishing up the pending projects.

You have a very pleasant day ahead. Though you are, by nature, restless and excitable you will be very steady and focused in whatever you do today. So says Ganesha. Later you will desire to enjoy the company of your friends and will call them over to chat and gossip with them. The evening will provide you lots of fun and laughter. You should be ending the day on a happy, contented note. You may invite a group of faithful friends over to your place or catch up a film with someone close to your heart. Your heart may feel the depth of intimacy. You can indulge in cuddling wth your partner. A wonderful night is on the cards, says Ganesha. A great day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This is the right time to attend work that is incomplete on all the fronts. With your energy levels moving upwards, you shall easily complete your tasks by end of the day. It is better to think twice before spending a huge sum. You should not take decisions blindly and should see to it that money is spent in right direction at right time. Forget unnecessary things for the time being. This is an excellent day to show your creative instinct. A sense of accomplishment should make you feel satisfied at work today. You’ve been working very hard. Therefore, your brain definitely deserves a break, feels Ganesha. Work on the projects that need your immediate attention and approval, says Ganesha.

You will be lost in the memories of the past today. You will be in a nostalgic frame of mind. Intellectual pursuits will attract you. Do not let your past lay a shadow upon your present and your future, says Ganesha. Your lovey-dovey attitude will appeal to your sweetheart, thus leading to a wonderful evening. Gossipping, teasing, cuddling and laughter will be some of the great recipes of the romantic night. A memorable time is on the cards, feels Ganesha. Today you may be in a mood to eat. You may wish to eat something of your choice. While you will surely enjoy food, you should remember that for good health – quantity also matters along with quality. Do not over-eat today. Ganesha suggests that you should remember that fast moving planets give only temporary happiness. Whatever you gain today may not give you lasting happiness, at least on the financial front. Today, you will be compassionate towards your fellow beings. Even your colleagues will appreciate you for your considerate attitude. You will approach tasks with enthusiasm and vigour. Your positive and versatile mindset will support you to finish important works on time, feels Ganesha.

In all likelihood, this is going to be a fairly easy day for you, says Ganesha. The only tough part of the day would be how to spend it. There will be hardly anything to do, anyone to talk to. Ideally, this is what you would call a perfect day. But not today. Today, you’ll miss people. You will find yourself more at peace with the unbearable chaos of the outer world than the deafening calm of your solitude. So, when you get your chance to rejoin the human race in its daily messy routine, you will be more than happy to oblige, says Ganesha. Your loved one will be happy and satisfied being with you. You will feel that you are spending the most amazing time with your loved one as you will understand your partner’s interests and need to have space, feels Ganesha. You will be in good health today. But, you are also likely to experience mood swings. You should avoid being over emotional about things as it may affect your health . Do not over-react to situations or people. Avoid fire to rise in your blood. Ganesha feels that today you shall be sensitive about financial matters. You may, though, get carried away by other people’s opinions. You need to be pragmatic and listen only to your inner voice. Today’s the best day of the month to plan a presentation. Just boost your confidence a bit. And then see your amazing presentation skills will come to the fore. Overcoming technical glitches will be child’s play for you. Work will be a fun today and your boss will applaud your ideas and effort.

A lot of people will sing your praises, however you will not be satisfied with whatever is occuring. The answers to some questions that have been bothering you will remain elusive. You may become emotional owing to feelings of personal loss. You will also be bothered about the near future, says Ganesha. In romance, don’t let the differences of opinion affect your relationship. Remember, you fell in love with your partner precisely because you found him/her different from the others. You want to make yourself special in front of your partner. Therefore, make the night memorable, suggests Ganesha. You need to take good care of your health today. Running nose to blockage of nose – anything can bother you today so you better beware. You should take sleep for enough hours today, else you may end up feeling tired and worked up. Financial benefits will give you temporal joy only. Instead, it will be good to invest money on spiritual advancement, meditation classes or something that helps you gain peace of mind. Cosmic undercurrents say that you need to focus only on one most important project. Understand the projects you plan to handle to the last detail so that you minimise the chances of going wrong in the future. Also, this will make your task easy to accomplish, suggests Ganesha.

Family affairs will predominate today. They will even control your thoughts to the exclusion of everything else. Things will look up on the business front. You may spend time relaxing in the evening. Ganesha says a trip to a place of worship is on the cards. You seem to be in high spirits. This attitude will melt your darling’s heart and make him/her agree to whatever you say. You are ruled by a deep emotion tonight and your appreciation for your lover will strengthen the current relationship, feels Ganesha. You will not face any major health issue today. You will have practical worries but there will be practical solutions too. You will stay energetic throughout the day. Your zeal will help you feel that ‘the day is going good’. Today you will be dealing with your finances very judiciously, feels Ganesha. You will not blow up your money impulsively on even things that you need to possess to maintain your level. An excellent day to begin a new job or a project! This is also the best day to give and take interviews. You are confident and ready to finish any task fast. Your active mind will not let you rest for a second.

Health is always a key issue, and today, you may have to pay some special attention to the same. It may be some elderly person in the family, or even you. Take the time to give it your full attention in order to avoid any further complications. You may do well to undergo a physical examination yourself. Remember, health is wealth. Take care. Ganesha wishes you a healthy day. Ganesha knows you are facing mounting work pressure. However, avoid being unfair to your loved one. Giving your partner utmost sincerity will be helpful in the long run. You may get some honey-filled compliments if you keep your relationship steady, feels Ganesha. Today, you will be able to perform multiple tasks without getting tired. You will be highly energetic today and you will use this energy properly. You will also be in a mood to take initiatives. It’s a good day from health perspective. Ganesha foresees that today is a very good day to focus on your career which will help bring more money. This is an auspicious day to learn about new ways and means to increase your financial standing. When the day begins, even your early achievement may not be able to help you see things clearly. However, a good time will relieve you in the second half of the day as the major workload will get lessened, feels Ganesha. Communication is likely to get better with your colleagues and superiors.

A cloud of emotions surrounds you today and you would like to spend the entire day in introspection and self-analysis. You will try to raise your bar at professional level. Your far sightedness and capability to understand human psychology promises a leader in you, says Ganesha. This is an ideal day to express your emotion in creative ways to stimulate your partner. Fortunately, your sweetheart will support you. You’ll be in quite a romantic mood today, and you will enjoy every moment of being together, feels Ganesha. You will be full of energy today. However, you should not use this energy in planning things. If you do so, you may end up making many changes in your plan and that’s not going to help you in any way. Today you shall have a fair idea about how much you want and how much you can let go. Such an attitude will help things to turn in your favour. In short, the day is good for negotiations. Ganesha foresees a lucky day for you. You will successfully wrap up routine tasks and then will get enough spaces to work on new projects. Your boss will be full of praise and appreciation for your dedication and performance.

Variety is the spice of life. Add variety of activities to your daily schedule and nothing would seem boring any more, foretells Ganesha. Indulge in creative activities like writing, cooking, gardening or even reading. Catch up with friends and memories of old times; have a blast!. Mental disturbances are likely to occur as the current astral alignment may lead to conflicts between you and your lover. Be on your guards. Once your loved one gets hurt, do not forget to make her feel at home by singing a soulful song or preparing a delicious dish. You need to give priority to your health and stay focussed there. If you don’t give importance to your health today, you may end up falling sick. You should not tax your brain much and just remain as silent as possible. Ganesha predicts that today you are not going to be smart in financial dealings. You will be spending money without thinking deeply about gains or returns. You need to keep your fists tight. Be very careful of your words as jealous colleagues may plan to undermine your position in the office. If you turn aggressive, just tone down a bit to control the situation, suggests Ganesha. Today, small tasks will keep you engaged. Your primary objectives may get reshuffled.

You’ll have apparently no time for anything else, as partnerships and projects will keep you on your toes. You communication skills and diplomacy will fetch you accolades in meetings, and also enable you to judge a person or a situation correctly, and form the right opinion. The efforts you have in the past may come to fruition today, feels Ganesha. Your willingness to fulfill the demands of your sweetheart will help you enjoy a wonderful evening, says Ganesha. If you feel that you cannot melt his or her heart at a go, you can sing, dance or crack some nice jokes, says Ganesha. You may not be in full energy today. You may feel bit tired as the day progresses. You should deal with things that can give you feeling of accomplishment and must not get involved in thankless tasks. You should also have juice and energy boosters. As a rule you tend to be calculative when it comes to financial matters, and you spend only after careful thought. However, today, you are likely to be carried away by peer pressure. It seems that you are the most sought-after person in the office. However, unfortunately, it’s all work and no play today. Filling up the monthly planner will be on the top of your mind. Your priorities at the workplace may get reorganised, foresees Ganesha.

You will be able to strike a balance between the emotional and rational side of your personality. You will find pleasure in your work and may successfully mix your personal life into your professional life. Financially, there are no major issues, but negligible matters may keep your mind occupied, feels Ganesha. You seem to be tensed today because of certain internal conflict and may forget to talk about important matters to your loved one. Take a break and spend some time with your partner, suggests Ganesha. Perhaps you will be able to get all your desired solutions from your sweetheart. Today you should take things easy and avoid taking too much stress. You should not say ‘yes’ for everything and must learn to say ‘no’ to things that are not possible to handle today. Ganesha feels that you may face temporary health issue. Ganesha foresees that the stars are in your favour if you are about to start providing services to some organization. You may be paid well for your services. While quoting a price, ensure that you are not short-changed. Today may be the worst day at your workplace since you may not be able to manage or organize tasks properly, foresees Ganesha. Your seniors may disagree with you as you may not be decisive. With problems multiplying, you may lose your cool.

You could find yourself re-establishing contact with long lost friends abroad, possibly on matters of business. You will also likely find yourself attending social events. There is a possibility that those who are unmarried, may find their match in these social settings. Long term personal or business relationships will likely be established today, says Ganesha. If you are planning for a baby, then this is the right day to make a move as it favours conception, foresees Ganesha. After all, you will be blissful realising that you are going to welcome an important member to your family. Your day is going to be good from health point of view. You will be at ease and in good mood. Your creativity will be very active today. You should keep yourself detached from anything that can trouble you emotionally. This is going to be a good day on the financial front, feels Ganesha. You will be able to spend money on yourself and family members. Fortunately, you will receive your desired financial benefits. It’s better if you avoid taking up any risky venture since Ganesha predicts that today’s astral configuration isn’t favourable. At work, you may fear that you will be the one to get the axe. You may turn indecisive in the second half, feels Ganesha.
